description: Pull the text out of a screenshot, photo, receipt or sign from its URL. Read the text in an image (OCR): screenshots, photos of signs, receipts, slides, scanned pages. Returns the text in reading order with line breaks, and whether any text was found. JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP up to 5 MB from a public URL. Price: $0.01 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.
